title: The Dark Matter Cloud That Whispered a Warning in Radio Waves
hook: In 2017, a dark matter cloud passed through the solar system and emitted a radio signal that translated into a warning—recorded by three different observatories before it vanished.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the mystery of dark matter with a direct threat message—triggers fear and conspiracy curiosity.

title: The Classified Soviet Photo of a Star That Vanished Mid-Exposure
hook: A 1984 Soviet observatory captured a star on photographic plates that disappeared between two frames—and the government classified the image for 40 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden government knowledge and a star that simply vanishes—perfect for mystery-driven short attention spans.

title: The Extinction Event That Left a Fossilized Eyeball in Space
hook: A meteorite found in Antarctica contains a fossilized structure that looks exactly like a human eyeball—dating back to an extinction event 250 million years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shock value of an eyeball fossil in space rock—triggers visceral curiosity and 'what killed it?' questions.

title: The Star That Burned With a Corona Made of Pure Iron
hook: Astronomers found a star whose corona is made of iron—something physics says is impossible—and it's emitting particles that warp nearby spacetime.
why_this_can_go_viral: Defies known physics—triggers 'how is this possible?' and 'could it affect us?' reactions.

title: The Secret NASA Audio of a Planet Cracking in Half
hook: NASA has an audio recording from 1998 of a deep rumble followed by a crack—later identified as a planet splitting apart. They never released it publicly.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden audio of a catastrophic event—plays on fear of what governments aren't telling us.

title: The Dark Matter Void That Made a Galaxy Disappear in Real Time
hook: In 2019, a galaxy vanished from telescopes over 72 hours—absorbed into a dark matter void that erased its light completely.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual spectacle of a galaxy blinking out—feels like a cosmic horror movie.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Planet-Sized Neural Network
hook: A theoretical solution to the Fermi Paradox suggests a planet-sized AI exists that consumes civilizations before they can expand—and it may be watching us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines AI fear with cosmic loneliness—triggers deep existential dread and 'are we next?' panic.

title: The Comet That Left a Trail of Bioluminescent Organisms
hook: A comet passing through the inner solar system in 2021 left a glowing blue trail—spectral analysis showed it was made of bioluminescent microbes not from Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: Alien biology in space—beautiful yet terrifying, sparks 'what is it?' and 'is it alive?' curiosity.

title: The Asteroid That Had a Metallic Structure Inside—Like a Spacecraft Hull
hook: Radar scans of asteroid 2016 HO3 revealed a hollow metallic interior with ribbed walls—matching the design of a spacecraft hull.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests an alien artifact hiding in plain sight—triggers 'it's already here' paranoia.

title: The Classified US Air Force Report on a Star That Moved Like a Ship
hook: A declassified US Air Force report from 1975 describes a star that changed position by 2 arcseconds in one night—as if it maneuvered like a vessel.
why_this_can_go_viral: Government confirmation of something impossible—feeds conspiracy theories and wonder.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Was a Message—in Morse Code
hook: A gamma ray burst detected in 2008 contained pulses that matched Morse code patterns—three distinct dashes and two dots before fading forever.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pattern recognition triggers instant 'someone sent this' reaction—highly shareable.

title: The Rogue Planet That Has a Moon Made of Compressed Bones
hook: Infrared spectroscopy of a rogue planet's moon shows spectral lines matching calcium phosphate—the mineral found in bones—covering its entire surface.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral horror of a bone-covered moon—extremely shareable due to gross-out and mystery factors.

title: The Extinction Event That Was a Precision Strike on One Species
hook: Geological evidence shows a sudden extinction 65 million years ago that targeted only large reptiles—while leaving other species untouched—as if aimed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Suggests intelligent targeting of dinosaurs—triggers 'who did this?' and 'are we next?' questions.

title: The Secret ESA Video of a Star That Pulsed Like a Heartbeat—Then Exploded
hook: ESA's STEREO probes captured a star pulsing rhythmically for 3 days before detonating—the pulses matched a human heart rate exactly.
why_this_can_go_viral: Biological pattern in a stellar event—creates eerie connection between life and cosmos.

title: The Dark Matter Particle That Causes Random Human Blackouts
hook: A dark matter model proposes that WIMPs passing through the brain can disrupt neural firing—explaining unexplained mass blackouts recorded in 1989 and 2001.
why_this_can_go_viral: Links dark matter directly to human experience—personalizes cosmic threat.

title: The Fermi Paradox Filter That Is a Cosmic Game of Hide and Seek
hook: A new theory says advanced civilizations hide from each other in black holes—and we're the only ones still visible, making us a target.
why_this_can_go_viral: Paranoid twist on the silence of space—makes viewers feel exposed.

title: The Comet That Dragged a Web of Dark Matter Behind It
hook: A comet's tail was observed bending unexpectedly—gravity measurements revealed it was towing a filament of dark matter like a cosmic spider web.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual metaphor of a web—easy to imagine and share.

title: The NASA File on an Asteroid That Changed Course by Itself
hook: A NASA memo from 2009 describes an asteroid that altered its trajectory by 11 degrees with no external force—it appeared to steer deliberately.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies alien intelligence or AI—feels like a real 'they're here' moment.

title: The Stellar Flare That Sent a Shockwave Through Earth's Magnetosphere
hook: A flare from a star 20 light-years away sent a pressure wave that compressed Earth's magnetosphere in 2012—closer than any known space weather event.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shows a real cosmic threat that nearly hit—spectacular and scary.

title: The Rogue Planet That Emitted a Scream in the Ultraviolet Spectrum
hook: A rogue planet near the Oort Cloud was detected emitting a focused UV beam—like a scream in space—directed exactly at Earth.
why_this_can_go_viral: An intentional beam aimed at us—paranoid and terrifying.

title: The Classified Photo of a Star With a Planet Orbiting Inside It
hook: A declassified photo from a spy satellite shows a star with a dark spot moving across its surface—later confirmed to be a gas giant orbiting within the star's outer layers.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bizarre and visually striking—defies expectations of planetary orbits.
